upgradeLevelRecord.verdict: PRODUCT BUG: the upgrade stat is applied but player.data.upgrades never records {key,level}; core case apply-upgrade calls applyUpgrade(def,data,level) which only runs def.apply(), while the helper applyUpgradeToPlayer() (which pushes the level) is now unused.

inventoryEquip.verdict: CONTRACT MISMATCH (not a product bug in the equip rule): the equip command commits on the next core tick (weaponKey changes), but the PauseScene EQUIP/EQUIPPED label row is only re-rendered by refreshWeapons() which runs at click time — before the commit — so the row never reflects the committed state while the overlay stays open.

economyTerminal.verdict: CONTRACT MISMATCH in the test fixture, but the underlying condition is a product rule: the test only advances through the portal, so the destination room still has live enemies and other rooms are spawned&&!cleared, so safeRoom() legitimately returns undefined and the terminal never opens.
